notes.title: Join our Discord server
notes.content:
Hello everyone. 

Come join our discord server where you can leave feedback, chat with me and take part in all kinds of other cool stuff and most importantly get access to early releases and features before they are available to everyone else!

Invite link:

https://discord.gg/NcDhmrc


Community support is essential to me so every little bit counts! 
I love feedback and want to make this game as good as it can be and that means listening to you.
